question: If nabla stands for operation "adding the first number to thrice the second number", then the value of (4nabla 5)nabla 6 will be:
solution:
BODMAS Rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97072bdd1f5e802223d1f8f5b1a4b12c68165fa67f70d7e53e21992716e4924c.png] 

According to the given information, 

**nabla = 1st number + (3 x 2ⁿd number)** -------- (i)

Given: (4 nabla 5)nabla 6

Applying (i), we will get,

= [4 + (**__3 times 5__**)] nabla 6

Using BODMAS Rule, we get,

= [__**4 + 15**__] nabla 6

Solving the bracket, we will get,

= 19 nabla 6

Again applying (i), we will get,

= 19 + (__**3 times 6**__)

Using BODMAS Rule, we get,

= __**19 + 18**__

= 37

Hence, the value of the given expression is '__**37**__'.
